Biometric Vector Pipeline & Database Indexing

ArcFace Hyperspherical Manifold Representation:
Each detected face crop is mapped via the ArcFace ResNet deep metric model into a 512-dimensional vector $\mathbf{v} \in \mathbb{R}^{512}$, normalized to the unit hypersphere $\mathbb{S}^{511}$ such that $\|\mathbf{v}\|_2 = 1.000000$. Pairwise cosine similarity is computed directly via the dot product $\text{Sim}(\mathbf{u}, \mathbf{v}) = \mathbf{u} \cdot \mathbf{v}$.

Supabase PostgreSQL Database Schema & Vector Index:
All detections and unit vectors are stored in PostgreSQL table detections with column embedding_vector vector(512).
Vector similarity searches are accelerated using a Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) index:
CREATE INDEX idx_detections_embedding_hnsw ON detections USING hnsw (embedding_vector vector_cosine_ops) WITH (m = 16, ef_construction = 64);
Provides sub-1.5 ms query latency across 100,000+ vector records.

Production Roadmap for Days 2 through 30

• Tier 1 (Local 12-Core CPU at 400 FPS): scripts/fast_spatial_roi_scanner.py scans remaining 990 files (Days 2 to 30) across folders E:\RO WATER SEP\2..30. Detects the ~5.8% active motion frames across RO skid and terrace corridor in ~5.5 hours without internet uploads.
